outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns its gripper with the handle (frames 35–84, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 99–121, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases the handle around frames 123–126, and the drawer remains visibly open through frame 150 (image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
